body: "the scarf is a metaphor," taylor said about all too well. then she started to explain what it's a metaphor for -- and stopped herself mid-sentence: "i think when i say it's a metaphor... i'm just going to stop." a song that began as a 10-to-20-minute improvised rant at a 2011 rehearsal, never released as a single, debuted at no. 80 -- and became the heart of red anyway.
